example_sentences_in_bangla: খারাপ খবর শুনে তার মুখ শুকিয়ে গেল।
পরীক্ষায় ফেল করায় ছেলেটির মুখ শুকানো।
example_sentences_in_english: His face dried up upon hearing the bad news.
The boy's face turned pale after failing the exam.
note: This idiom vividly captures emotional distress through the imagery of a face losing its vitality, common in Bengali expressive language.
